meta.held: SB-PK-3 (elemental-P vs P2O5 ambiguity + Mardan/KPK miscoding), J-IN-3 (jute SEED-production — never a fibre dose), R-IN-1 (rye: low-confidence media source, K>N anomaly), barley/chickpea PK (no official data after 3 passes).
meta.notesConvention: FertilizerRecommendation has no notes column (batches 1-6 pattern). Caveats mapped to: variety (perennial stage labels, batch-6 coffee precedent), soilContext (rubber Mg-normal vs Mg-rich series), applicationMethod (trial-status, oxide-convention caveats, agro-ecology scoping, grade/conversion math), applicationTiming (split schedules, sowing detail), Source.notes (provenance caveats). isPrimary: official institution schedules only (Rubber Board via KAU, NIPHM GoI). Trial/advisory/teaching records stay non-primary. Perennial doses are kg/ha/YEAR — stated in variety/applicationTiming.
meta.regionMapping: Research 'in' (rubber, national) -> regionSlug null (country-wide, batch-6 coffee convention); rubber/oil palm get no windows (perennial plantation crops, batch-6 coffee precedent). No new regions (pk-punjab, in-tn already exist).
meta.scope: Held-record resolutions (item 1): sunflower S-PK-2 (UAF Faisalabad 150-100-62, central Punjab), lentil PK 52.3-57-0 (Shah et al. 2025), sugar beet SB-PK-2 150-100-62.5 (trial rate, Leiah). Batch 7 (item 2): triticale (3), rubber (9), oil palm (5) — all India; rye R-IN-1 EXCLUDED (low-confidence media source, treated as gap). SB-PK-3 and J-IN-3 NOT populated (held/excluded per resolution report). Pakistan barley/chickpea: confirmed gaps (3rd pass), nothing populated. All records import as verified — NEVER verified on import.
